one_line: A devoted 7th‑century Kamarupi court scribe preserving royal orders in Sanskrit on copper plates with evolving regional script forms.

appearance.age_look: mid-20s, lean and slightly bookish build
appearance.face: oval face with soft jawline, medium-brown complexion, fine straight nose, calm almond-shaped eyes with a focused gaze, thin arched eyebrows, and a default expression of quiet concentration with a hint of pride.
appearance.hair: black hair parted in the middle, tied into a neat low bun at the back of the head; a narrow white cotton headband wraps around the forehead, with its knot hidden behind the bun.
appearance.costume: A knee-length, off-white handwoven cotton uttariya draped over both shoulders and wrapped snugly around the torso, worn over a light beige, long-sleeved, mid-thigh kurta-like tunic, paired with ankle-length plain brown cotton dhoti-style lower garment pleated in front and tied at the waist; simple dark-brown leather sandals; a thin copper waist-cord peeks at the tied knot, a single small copper pendant hangs at the chest, and a rolled palm-leaf pouch hangs from the left hip; subtle woven borders in muted maroon edge the uttariya and dhoti.
appearance.signature: A rectangular reddish-brown copper plate with rounded corners and a central hole, inscribed with fine lines of Kamarupi script, held together with a ring and an attached small elephant-shaped copper seal, carried in his left hand along with a stylus-like iron writing tool in the right.

ref_desc: A mid-20s Kamarupi scribe with black hair in a low bun and a white headband, wearing an off-white uttariya over a light beige tunic and brown dhoti with muted maroon borders, leather sandals, and carrying copper-plate documents with an elephant seal and iron stylus.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of a mid-20s Kamarupi court scribe: an oval-faced, medium-brown man with a calm, focused expression, black hair parted and tied into a neat low bun, and a narrow white cotton headband across his forehead. Show him in an off-white handwoven cotton uttariya draped over both shoulders and wrapped around his torso, over a light beige, long-sleeved, mid-thigh tunic, with an ankle-length plain brown cotton dhoti-style lower garment pleated in front and tied at the waist. Add subtle woven borders in muted maroon on the uttariya and dhoti, simple dark-brown leather sandals, a thin copper waist-cord visible at the knot, a single small copper pendant on his chest, and a rolled palm-leaf pouch hanging from his left hip. In his left hand he holds a rectangular reddish-brown copper plate with rounded corners and a central hole, inscribed with fine script lines and bound on a ring with a small elephant-shaped copper seal, while his right hand carries a slender iron stylus-like writing tool. Use off-white, light beige, brown, muted maroon, and copper tones to keep the design consistent, and present him from multiple angles to clearly show hair, draped garments, and his copper-plate documents with elephant seal and stylus.
